nodes.name: Raiwala (Cheela Reach)
nodes.description: Pristine Himalayan meltwater entry from Rajaji National Park foothills upstream of urban Haridwar.

nodes.name: Motichur Confluence
nodes.description: Natural forest stream confluence with gravelly riverbed and crystal-clear mountain currents.

nodes.name: Bhimgoda Barrage Upstream
nodes.description: Major barrage holding snowmelt reservoir before diversion into Upper Ganges Canal.

nodes.name: Bhimgoda Barrage Spillway
nodes.description: Regulated discharge point into the natural Ganga channel with boulder bed and high velocity.

nodes.name: Har Ki Pauri (Brahmakund)
nodes.description: Holy pilgrimage ghat with mass ritual bathing, religious offerings, and daily evening Ganga Aarti crowds.

nodes.name: Mayapur Headworks
nodes.description: British-era canal diversion headworks feeding the Upper Ganges Canal network across western UP.

nodes.name: Kassaban & Lalta Rao Outfall
nodes.description: Municipal drainage outfall carrying untreated commercial and domestic wastewater from old Haridwar town.

nodes.name: Kankhal (Daksheshwar Reach)
nodes.description: Historic religious town reach with ashrams, temple ghats, and residential runoff.

nodes.name: Jagjeetpur STP Outfall
nodes.description: Haridwar's primary wastewater discharge zone (68 MLD + 27 MLD STP facility) entering the main stem.

nodes.name: Matri Sadan / Sitarampur
nodes.description: Ecological conservation reach where river widens into braided gravel and sand channels.

nodes.name: SIIDCUL Industrial Canal
nodes.description: Confluence of industrial drainage carrying treated effluents from pharmaceutical and engineering manufacturing units.

nodes.name: Sultanpur Floodplain Reach
nodes.description: Broad agricultural floodplain reach with seasonal sandbanks and farming runoff.

nodes.name: Laksar Agro-Sugar Reach
nodes.description: Sub-catchment receiving seasonal sugarcane crushing and processing wastewater during winter months.

nodes.name: Balawali Bridge (District Exit)
nodes.description: Corridor exit point at the railway bridge near UP border; Solani river confluence downstream.
